subject: SELF and SUPER
notes: kb/Work PB1425 (w1020c). "SELF and SUPER are both implicitly described as class object and category object reference, and are not universal object references" (cite.py --check 8.4.3.8.3 -> OK 7)). SELF as an operand is a compiler temporary described ACTIVE-CLASS (FACTORY OF in a factory method) - class object, not universal, the class of the object the method was invoked on (8.4.3.8.4 GR1) - so it is compared as class object (8.8.4.2.15: IF O = SELF, IF SELF = A, EVALUATE SELF WHEN O, in an instance and a factory method), passed as an object-reference argument (BY CONTENT / BY VALUE / bare, inline), raised (GOBACK RAISING SELF, the 14.9.18.3 SR4 c) ACTIVE-CLASS check), and refused in an arithmetic expression by 8.8.1.1 (COBOL0844) under every dialect - --permissive's digit decoding no longer reaches class object or pointer (it used to end in a Roslyn CS1503). SET's SELF sender keeps its named rules (14.9.39.3 SR10 d) / SR12 c) / SR14 b)). [editions: the OO facility, 2002+]
